purpose: Determine whether the rejected q1 inner-SCF instability is specific to Pulay ALPHA=0.5 without changing the physical model or mixing algorithm.
corrected_electronic_energy_definition: E_KS = W - lambda*r, with lambda and residual r taken from the same final ordered CDFT trace point.

acceptance.same_state: Both independent runs converge and every registered difference is within tolerance.
acceptance.multiple_solution_sensitivity: Both runs converge but at least one registered state diagnostic exceeds tolerance.
acceptance.q1_inner_scf_unresolved: Neither damped q1 run converges; run restricted q2 only as a general SCF control.
acceptance.one_sided: Only one run converges; no state-uniqueness conclusion is permitted.

scope: These are numerical pilot tolerances, not physical model uncertainties or validation of q1 or q2.
